mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDPC1 indicates strong economic growth, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX returns are negative over 60 days in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising UNRATE above 7% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 7% but SPX returns are positive in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS and high UNRATE indicate accommodative policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and UNRATE conditions met but SPX returns are negative >30%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS increases but SPX returns are positive >40%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL indicates inflation, leading to potential rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL growth is positive but SPX returns are positive >50%.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing INDPRO signals strong production, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is positive but SPX returns are negative >40%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDPC1 growth and rising PAYEMS indicate economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and PAYEMS conditions met but SPX returns are negative >30%.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing RSAFS indicates strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth is positive but SPX returns are negative >40%.
